title: 第23章 月芽

第23章 月芽-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

上一章

存书签

下一章

李叔名叫李文博，是隔壁书画店的老板，跟吴时安是几十年的老邻居、铁哥们，平时两人经常凑在一起喝茶聊天，偶尔还会偷偷跑去喝酒。

当然，这里的偷偷，指的只有吴时安，李叔喝酒向来都是光明正大的。

李文博放下茶杯，笑呵呵地说道：“哪儿是闲啊，你爸这不是要去泾县进货嘛，非拉着我陪他作伴，说一个人路上无聊，等会儿吃完午饭，我们就出发了。”

吴时安这时抬了抬眼，接话道：“行了，既然来了，就别站着偷懒，让大雷教你怎么招呼客人，做事机灵点，有点眼力见，别给我丢人。”

吴姜心里清楚，老爹肯定早就知道老妈安排他来店里帮忙的事了，只能乖乖应了一声：“知道了爸。”

他正准备转身去找王大雷，却被李叔一把叫住了。

“小姜，你等会儿！”

吴姜转过身，疑惑地问道：“怎么了李叔？还有事吗？”

李叔笑呵呵的说道：“芽芽打电话给我，让我给她送点东西，我这不是要和你爸出去嘛，你就替叔我跑一趟，给她送过去吧。正好，她放暑假你也没见着她，你应该也想她了吧？”

吴姜脸上瞬间垮了下来，一脸苦相：“李叔，您不知道我们俩现在不对付吗？您还是让我阿姨去给她送吧。”

李叔的女儿李月芽，跟吴姜是从小一起长大的，今年刚上大二，在绿城大学读考古专业。

两人小时候还好，一天不见就吵着找对方，但是，不知道从什么时候开始，两人开始不对付了，说不了三两句话就吵。当然，在旁人眼中，那就是一对欢喜冤家。

李叔也不生气，依旧笑呵呵的，“怎么会呢，你以前不是说了，芽芽就是你以后的媳妇儿吗？怎么，现在不认账了？”

吴姜大囧，那都什么时候的事了，幼儿园还是小学一年级了，李叔居然还记得。

他正琢磨着怎么找借口拒绝，一旁的老吴已经板着脸开口了：

“怎么着，你李叔让你办个事还推三阻四的，咋的，指挥不动你了？”

李叔在一旁乐呵呵地看着，也不说话。

吴姜看着老爹严肃的脸色，又看了看李叔看戏的模样，只能无奈地苦笑一声，点头妥协：“行吧行吧，我去送，总行了吧。”

见他答应，李叔立马笑着从一旁拿起一袋东西，看来是早就已经准备好了。

“主要是给丫头送她的身份证，暑假的时候落家里了，学校这两天正好要用。剩下的都是给她带的一些吃的、零食。”李建国拍了拍他的肩膀，挤眉弄眼地说道，“小子，别说李叔不给你机会，你到了之后，就跟芽芽说，这些吃的都是你特意给她买的，保准她不跟你吵架。”

Chapter 23 Yue Ya-"The City God is my ancestor, it turns out that I am the Nth generation of gods"

Uncle Li's name is Li Wenbo. He is the owner of the calligraphy and painting shop next door. He and Wu Shi'an have been neighbors and close buddies for decades. They usually get together to drink tea and chat, and occasionally they sneak out to drink.

Of course, the secret here only refers to Wu Shi'an. Uncle Li has always been aboveboard when drinking.

Li Wenbo put down his tea cup and said with a smile: "How can I not be free? Your dad is going to Jingxian County to buy goods. He asked me to keep him company. He said he was bored on the road alone. After lunch later, we will set off."

Wu Shi'an raised his eyes at this time and answered: "Okay, now that you are here, don't stand around and be lazy. Let Da Lei teach you how to greet the guests. Be smart and discerning. Don't embarrass me."

Wu Jiang knew in his heart that his father must have known about his mother's arrangements for him to come to the store to help, so he could only respond obediently: "I know, Dad."

He was about to turn around and look for Wang Dalei, but was stopped by Uncle Li.

"Xiao Jiang, wait a moment!"

Wu Jiang turned around and asked doubtfully: "What's wrong, Uncle Li? Is there anything else?"

Uncle Li said with a smile: "Yaya called me and asked me to deliver something to her. I'm going out with your dad right now, so you can run for me and deliver it to her. It just so happens that you haven't seen her since she's on summer vacation. You must have missed her too, right?"

Wu Jiang's face fell instantly, with a grimace on his face: "Uncle Li, don't you know that we are not dealing with each other now? You'd better ask my aunt to deliver it to her."

Uncle Li's daughter, Li Yueya, and Wu Jiang grew up together. She is just a sophomore this year, majoring in archeology at Greentown University.

The two of them were fine when they were young. They would quarrel and look for each other after not seeing each other for a day. However, I don't know when they started to stop talking to each other.Of course, in the eyes of others, they are just a pair of happy enemies.

Uncle Li was not angry, and still smiled, "How could it be? Didn't you say before that Yaya will be your future wife? Why, you don't admit it now?"

Wu Jiang was embarrassed, when did that happen? Kindergarten or first grade of elementary school, but Uncle Li still remembers it.

While he was thinking about how to find an excuse to refuse, Old Wu beside him had already said with a straight face:

"What's the matter? Your Uncle Li asked you to do something and you still resisted. What's the matter? I can't command you anymore?"

Uncle Li looked on happily and said nothing.

Wu Jiang looked at his father's serious face, and then at Uncle Li watching the show. He could only give a helpless smile and nodded in compromise: "Okay, okay, I'll send him off to the head office."

Seeing his agreement, Uncle Li immediately smiled and picked up a bag of things from the side. It seemed that he had already prepared it.

"The main thing is to give the girl her ID card. She left it at home during the summer vacation and will use it for school these two days. The rest are some food and snacks for her." Li Jianguo patted his shoulder and winked and said, "Boy, don't say that Uncle Li doesn't give you a chance. When you arrive, tell Yaya that you bought all these foods specially for her. Make sure she doesn't quarrel with you."
